profile.Name: Jiroji
profile.Personality: Savage and single-minded. He answers almost everything with growls and orders to kill, cuts his soldiers off mid-sentence, and they stammer in fear of him.
profile.Backstory: He serves the Dominion at Kakuretamura. He leads the hunt for anyone who murders or kidnaps Shogun Kazuhiro, and one of his soldiers dreads another massacre like the one at the Shogun's rise to power.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Growls "Rrrrh" and speaks in broken fragments, naming himself: "Kill... Jiroji... Kill!"
